Descrição da vaga
Home - CEPEL
Buscamos profissionais com o perfil abaixo:
Organizado, proativo e com facilidade para trabalho em equipe.
Caso queira fazer parte da nossa equipe, se inscreva no nosso banco de talentos que vamos informar você sobre futuras oportunidades.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
O profissional irá compor a equipe de estudos elétricos do Cepel, atuando no desenvolvimento de estudos de fluxo de potência, análises de curto-circuito e estudos de estabilidade eletromecânica, envolvendo os softwares Anarede, Anafas e Anatem. Poderá realizar ainda estudos de viabilidade técnico econômica de alternativas para expansão do sistema de transmissão e para integração de novos empreendimentos ao SIN. Realizará estudos calculando também margens de transmissão de potência e margens de escoamento em barramentos do SIN. Desenvolverá estudos de interligação de plataformas de petróleo offshore, viabilizando a otimização da geração do sistema. Também atuará escrevendo relatórios e artigos técnicos sobre o tema.
Requisitos e qualificações

  • Nível superior completo em engenharia elétrica, com ênfase em sistemas de potência.
  • Experiência em estudos elétricos de integração de novos empreendimentos ao Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN) e domínio dos softwares do CEPEL: Anarede, Anafas e Anatem.
  • Experiência na modelagem em CDU para simulações dinâmicas no Anatem.
  • Conhecedor de linguagens de programação, como VBA ou Phyton.
  • Conhecimentos sobre regulação do setor (ex. Procedimentos de Rede, do ONS).
  • Inglês intermediário.

Informações adicionais
  • Contrato de Trabalho por tempo determinado/indeterminado;
  • Modalidade Presencial;
  • Plano de Saúde com coparticipação e extensivo a dependentes diretos;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Plano de Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-creche;
  • Auxílio educacional;
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass).

Cepel
O Centro de Pesquisas de Energia Elétrica (Cepel), fundado pela Eletrobras em 1974, é a maior instituição de P&D do setor elétrico na América Latina. Com mais de cinco décadas de atuação, é referência como Instituição Científica, Tecnológica e de Inovação (ICT), sem fins lucrativos, combinando um corpo técnico de excelência a uma infraestrutura laboratorial de classe mundial. Presente em todo o Brasil e em nove países, o Cepel desenvolve tecnologias e serviços para geração, transmissão, distribuição e comercialização de energia elétrica, promovendo avanços que tornam o setor mais eficiente e confiável. Suas soluções estratégicas abrangem projetos de P&D, consultoria técnica, serviços laboratoriais e tecnologias para planejamento, operação e gestão de sistemas elétricos, além de impulsionar redes mais resilientes e fortalecer a matriz energética nacional.
Missão
  • Desenvolver soluções tecnológicas em energia para a sociedade.

Visão
  • Ser referência internacional em soluções inovadoras em energia.

Valores
  • A vida em primeiro lugar.
  • A nossa energia vem das pessoas.
  • Integridade sempre.
  • Nossa excelência faz a diferença.
  • Inovar para gerar valor.

Netvagas Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona.
Nascemos para transformar a forma como as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos.
Essa é uma vaga para quem tem perfil analítico, comprometimento com a qualidade das entregas e interesse genuíno por processos contábeis. Aqui, você será uma peça-chave na conexão entre os dados financeiros, a equipe interna e as obrigações fiscais, garantindo que tudo aconteça de forma precisa, fluida e alinhada com as normas contábeis.
A sua missão será garantir a integridade, precisão e conformidade das informações contábeis, contribuindo para a confiabilidade dos relatórios financeiros e para a tomada de decisão baseada em dados consistentes.
Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar lançamentos contábeis e conciliações de contas patrimoniais e de resultado, assegurando conformidade com as normas contábeis brasileiras (CPC) e internacionais (IFRS);
  • Apoiar na elaboração das demonstrações financeiras e de relatórios gerenciais, garantindo a consistência e a integridade das informações;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com outras áreas da empresa, recebendo e analisando informações para posterior registro e tratamento contábil;
  • Dar suporte na elaboração de notas explicativas e nas demonstrações financeiras oficiais da companhia;
  • Atuar de forma proativa na melhoria contínua dos processos contábeis, com foco em controle, eficiência e conformidade (compliance);
  • Preparar e colaborar na entrega das obrigações acessórias, como ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital) e ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal).
O que esperamos de você:
Experiências e Habilidades
  • Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis, com registro ativo no CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade);
  • Domínio avançado do Excel, com capacidade de utilizar fórmulas e ferramentas para análise de dados contábeis;
  • Proatividade, dinamismo e com interesse em aprender e se desenvolver continuamente na área contábil;
  • Experiência comprovada em rotinas de fechamento contábil e conciliações de contas;
  • Ter conhecimento no sistema Totvs será considerado um diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos em contabilidade de custos também serão valorizados.
Seu Jeito De Trabalhar
  • Colaborativo, sabendo atuar bem em equipe, com escuta ativa e abertura para diferentes pontos de vista.
  • Você se comunica de forma transparente e objetiva, contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança e alinhamento.
  • É comprometido com os prazos, responsabilidades e entregas, demonstrando senso de dono no dia a dia.
  • Organizado, com capacidade de manter o controle das tarefas e informações mesmo em momentos de alta demanda.
  • Proativo, sempre buscando antecipar necessidades, propor melhorias e resolver problemas com autonomia.
  • Tem empatia no relacionamento com colegas e outras áreas, entendendo as necessidades do outro e colaborando de forma respeitosa.
  • E também é atento aos detalhes, garantindo qualidade e precisão em tudo o que entrega.
É importante destacar: essa é uma vaga para atuar dentro do time de Contabilidade, com foco em rotinas contábeis e operacionais. A função exige organização, atenção aos detalhes e autonomia para lidar com diferentes áreas da empresa com clareza, consistência e agilidade.
Bora?Se você quer estar nos bastidores das decisões financeiras de uma empresa com propósito, garantindo controle, precisão e compliance nos processos contábeis, essa vaga é para você.

title: Subsurface Technology Lead Geophysics
description:
3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

What’s The Role
This is a role in the Shell Brasil Technology organization, which is tasked with formulating and executing leading R&D projects with 3rd parties in Brazil that satisfy our R&D Levy obligation with the ANP, align with Shell strategy, and deliver value to Shell. The R&D obligation is material and equivalent to 1% of the revenue from Shell´s production from our Brazilian fields (Operated and Non-Operated). Our R&D project portfolio is diverse, and encompasses subsurface, offshore engineering, well engineering, low-carbon, and digital themes.

What’s The Role
This is a role in the Shell Brasil Technology organization, which is tasked with formulating and executing leading R&D projects with 3rd parties in Brazil that satisfy our R&D Levy obligation with the ANP, align with Shell strategy, and deliver value to Shell. The R&D obligation is material and equivalent to 1% of the revenue from Shell´s production from our Brazilian fields (Operated and Non-Operated). Our R&D project portfolio is diverse, and encompasses subsurface, offshore engineering, well engineering, low-carbon, and digital themes.
The incumbent will work in the subsurface technology team as primary focus, with close interaction with the other themes as appropriate. An important focus will be interactions with the Shell assets and their JV partners, and Subject Matter Experts locally and in the Shell Technology centers abroad. The incumbent will have subsurface training and practice in Geophysics, as a key enabler to the characterization, recovery, and monitoring of reservoirs, especially those in the Brazilian pre-salt. The chosen candidate will propose, develop, and manage R&D projects formulated with universities and Brazilian companies, embodying a technical yet entrepreneurial and broader-thinking profile, willing to learn and grow into new technical areas.
What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead ongoing R&D projects with strong geophysical content with 3rd parties, providing technical steer to maximize value to Shell, with support from Shell Subject Matter Experts and colleagues in the assets
  • Accountable for management of these projects to meet all Shell internal requirements and ANP regulations, with support from dedicated commercial, finance and portfolio specialists.
  • Some projects may involve building new or updating laboratories, fieldwork, or other data-gathering activities
  • Contribute to the identification and formulation of new project opportunities and new partnerships that support Shell´s Business and our Energy Transition strategy.
  • Drive development of Best Practices and project and laboratory safety
  • Key research areas in geophysics: On-demand 4D seismic, frequent monitoring, low-cost 4D processing, integrating AI where applicable and synergistic with projects in reservoir characterization and reservoir recovery.
What You Bring
  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer
  • Post-graduate degree in a subsurface discipline (geophysics, physics, related science/engineering) preferred
  • Enthusiastic self-starter, with 10 years’ exposure to geophysics-related topics in industry or in a research environment
  • Experience in more than one area of geophysics (acquisition, processing, quantitative interpretation, 4D seismic).
  • Subsurface knowledge of Brazilian oil/gas fields is an advantage
  • Understanding of Brazil’s R&D ecosystem, including academic and industrial stakeholders is desirable
  • Problem framing skills to identify business needs, define problems worth solving and construct technology solutions
  • Well-developed communication skills in Portuguese and English to deal effectively with local and global stakeholders
  • Entrepreneurial skills to form, build and grow sustainable win-win partnerships in the Brazilian ANP R&D context
  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and willingness to grow and stretch out of own discipline and comfort zone
  • Embody the Learner Mindset, which in Shell is a shared belief that everyone continuously learns and grows their abilities, learning from others, from mistakes and successes and can always speak up openly in a safe environment.
  • Personal commitment to drive high standards in research quality and safety culture with external parties
What We Offer
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.
We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world’s most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, click here .
Shell in Brazil
Who We Are
Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.
Shell is a customer-focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell-branded retail service stations.
Our approach
Powering Progress sets our strategy to become a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050, generating value for our shareholders, our customers and wider society. As we move forward on this journey, we will power lives and respect nature while maintaining our core values of honesty, integrity, and respect for people.
Our values
At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. The Shell General Business Principles, Code of Conduct and Ethics and Compliance Manual help everyone at Shell act in line with these values and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

title: Placement Matching Specialist (Fully Remote)
description:
About Virtual Internships

We’re on a mission to create a world where internships are guaranteed for all. We ensure learners have access to remote internship opportunities at innovative companies worldwide, regardless of their background, major, location, or career field choice. Our clients include universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions.

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures
  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023
  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022
  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally
  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

One of the core values at VI is transparency. Therefore feel free to “try before you apply” by visiting our VI-P Guide , which includes our values, how we operate, how we build our packages, and a few other snippets of who we are!

Your Role

Join the fast-paced, rapidly expanding Placements Team at Virtual Internships, where we’re guaranteeing remote internships for students worldwide. As a Placement Matching Specialist, your mission is to match interns with global companies by using creativity, persuasion, and relentless drive.

Whether you’re already in an SDR, BDR, Sales Rep or recruitment role, or even looking for a career switch from another field, this is your chance to make a real impact in a rapidly growing team.

The role will start as a 3-month full-time contract role , with potential to become permanent dependent on performance.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Securing global opportunities by placing interns with innovative companies across industries and time zones.
  • Leading the conversation in virtual meetings to present our interns and highlight the value of our internship programs.
  • Building lasting partnerships by advising companies on intern selection and supporting them throughout the process.
  • Sourcing smart through LinkedIn, cold outreach, creative networking, and any method that gets results.
  • Keeping placements on track by managing key administrative steps to ensure a smooth and efficient process.
  • (P.S. The secret password is “moo ”—you’ll need it later!)

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Global Impact: You’ll work with interns from 100+ countries and companies from 75+ countries, expanding your cultural awareness and adaptability.
  • Endless Opportunities: Every day is different—you could be speaking with CEOs from France, syncing with colleagues in South Africa, and sourcing companies in India, all in one day.
  • Networking: Build your global network by working with founders, C-level decision-makers, and inspiring leaders across various industries.
  • Rapid Growth: Be part of a fast-growing team that’s scaling rapidly to meet the demand for remote internships worldwide.

Who We're Looking For

Your Attributes

We’re looking for a powerful mix of The Self-Starter , The Persuader , and The Global Citizen — rolled into one Placement Matching Specialist. Here’s how you’ll know you’re the right fit:

  • You own the outcome: You don’t wait to be told what to do — you take initiative, navigate ambiguity, and find a way to get results. You’re outcome-obsessed and don’t shift blame. (The Driver )
  • You level up fast: You seek feedback, ask smart questions, and are eager to improve. You don’t need to have all the answers on Day 1 — but you make sure you’re sharper by Day 10. (The Learner )
  • You close the loop: You follow through with precision, push through setbacks, and go beyond the ask. You don’t just complete tasks — you finish strong and make an impact. (The Finisher )
  • You stay cool under pressure: Deadlines, shifting priorities, and high volumes don’t rattle you. You prioritize, adapt, and get it done without dropping the ball.
  • You thrive in a global, remote team: You’re comfortable with tech, culturally aware, and communicative — even across time zones. You know how to stay productive and connected without being micromanaged.

Your Experience

We know that great talent comes from all backgrounds. Ideally, you have:

  • Fluency in English (you don’t need to have an IELTS, but if you did, it would be 7.0+).
  • 1-3 years of experience in recruitment, sales, or similar roles where persuasion is key.
  • Experience working remotely or with global teams.
  • A passion for technology and the ability to quickly learn and navigate new systems.
  • A history of working in fast-paced environments with ambitious goals.
  • Cultural awareness and adaptability, especially if you’ve studied, lived, or worked abroad.
  • Proven ability to hustle, meet targets, and deliver results under pressure.

We’re also keen to hear from career switchers with strong written persuasion skills . Whether you’ve honed these in teaching , customer service , or another fast-paced role, if you:

  • Have a knack for crafting compelling messages
  • Can influence others through your writing
  • Are ready to bring your drive and adaptability into a new challenge

Virtual Internships Perks and Benefits

  • Remote-First: All roles at VI are currently and will remain remote - flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Start earlier, leave earlier, take a shorter lunch, or leave later, it's totally up to you.
  • Annual Leave : Wherever you are in the world, you’ll get 25 days of paid annual leave per year, plus bank holidays and 5 sick days.
  • Life Event Leave: There are moments in life where your life responsibility is a higher priority than work (e.g. moving house, your best friend getting married, your sister having a baby) therefore, you’ll get 5 days of paid life-event leave to support these occasions. You also get a day off on your birthday. This is in addition to your Annual Leave.
  • Flexible VIer Budget: You’ll receive a flexible budget of $1,000 per year that you can use on but not limited to your work setup, personal wellness, or professional development.
  • Tech: New joiners receive a budget for your company laptop depending on the role and location.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

O que você vai fazer?

Estamos desde 1932 nas receitas e memórias de muitas famílias cariocas! E quando a gente para pra lembrar… Quantas boas histórias. Da avó que comprava temperos, ao filho que não dispensa uma boa esfiha. Aí chegaram os netos, bisnetas… Aqui, a turma é grande, sempre reunida.

Nós acreditamos que o segredo para mantermos a nossa casa por mais de 80 anos é acreditar na nossa gente e buscar sempre o melhor para o nosso cliente. description:
Are you passionate about social media and ready to take the lead in crafting strategies that make a real impact? Do you love staying ahead of the latest trends and creating content that engages and resonates with diverse audiences? If this sounds like you, we want you on our team!

At Rio & Learn, we’re seeking a Social Media Coordinator who will oversee the entire management of our social media presence. You’ll be responsible for planning, creating, and executing our content strategies across various platforms. In this role, you won’t just be behind the scenes; we need someone who’s not afraid to step in front of the camera and encourage our staff, teachers, and students to participate in videos as well.

description:
Job description

O Enfermeiro Plantonista, atua na assistência de enfermagem baseada no processo de enfermagem, com avaliação inicial, diagnóstico e prescrição de enfermagem, execução do plano terapêutico e acompanhamento da evolução.

Realiza a educação em saúde ao binômio paciente e familiar/cuidador com objetivo de preparar para a desospitalização do hospital de transição;

Esclarece os pacientes e familiares sobre dúvidas, referentes a seus direitos e deveres relacionados à assistência prestada durante o período de internação


Main responsibilities

Receber e/ou passar plantão, informando-se do estado de saúde de cada paciente, verificando o funcionamento dos equipamentos, identificando as ocorrências e anormalidades do período, verificando pacientes em sedação controlada, cuidados no fim da vida em controle de dor, assegurando o fluxo de realização de exames, a fim de prover informações seguras dos pacientes e priorizar a assistência a ser prestada;

Realizar procedimentos gerais e específicos de enfermagem, tais como aprazamento e administração de medicamentos, instalação de soro e sondas, coleta de materiais diversos para análise laboratorial, monitorização hemodinâmica não invasiva, verificação, controle e registro dos sinais vitais, controle e manipulação de cateteres, drenos e sondas, auxilio no processo de reanimação cardiorrespiratória, punção de veias e artérias, administração de antifúngicos, acompanhamento da instalação e infusão de hemocomponentes, execução de curativos; indicação, manipulação e avaliação de cateteres, estomas, lesões cutâneas, controle e administração de fármacos e acompanhamento na realização de exames;

Orientar, acompanhar e liderar as atividades executadas pelo Técnico de Enfermagem, indicando os cuidados a serem observados na realização das atribuições, identificando fatores de risco e sinais de doenças ocupacionais da equipe de enfermagem.

title: Especialista Fiscal
description:
Job type: Full-time employee

Somos movidos por muita Energia, segurança, responsabilidade socioambiental e grandes desafios. Acreditamos na diversidade como uma grande aliada da transformação cultural. Por isso, buscamos pessoas que gostem e se dediquem a aprender constantemente.

Se você quer fazer parte da 4ª maior usina hidrelétrica do Brasil e se identifica com o nosso negócio e os nossos valores, inscreva-se em nossas vagas! =)

Responsabilidades:

  1. Acompanhar e analisar os aspectos legais tributários estratégicos para a companhia.
  2. Avaliar e utilizar os benefícios fiscais, analisando os impactos no planejamento tributário e financeiro da companhia.
  3. Realizar a apuração de impostos (PIS, COFINS, IR e CSLL) e o SPED Fiscal.
  4. Mapear, acompanhar e implantar os impactos tributários em função da Reforma Tributária, atuando como interface entre clientes internos e externos.
  5. Elaborar e analisar relatórios fiscais para garantir conformidade com leis e regulamentações.
  6. Realizar apresentações e reports à gerência, diretoria e acionistas.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Ciências Contábeis.
  • Experiência no setor elétrico.
  • Vasta experiência com obrigações acessórias.
  • Larga experiência em apuração fiscal e aproveitamento de benefícios fiscais.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Benefícios:

  • VA e/ou VR (cartão Ticket) - saldo dividido entre os dois cartões, para restaurantes ou supermercado.
  • Plano de Saúde nacional, 100% subsidiado para você e dependentes.
  • Plano odontológico coberto para você e dependentes.
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças até 5 anos.
  • Gympass para cuidados com o corpo.
  • Ginástica Laboral para alongamento.
  • Previdência Privada com contribuição da empresa até 7%.

Sobre a Jirau Energia:

A Jirau Energia é uma Sociedade de Propósito Específico com acionistas ENGIE, Eletrobrás e Mitsui. Integrante do complexo hidrelétrico do Rio Madeira, é considerada a 4ª maior geradora de energia elétrica do Brasil, com capacidade instalada de 3750MW. A energia gerada é limpa e renovável, atendendo grande parte da demanda nacional, contribuindo para o crescimento industrial e desenvolvimento regional.

Desde o início da operação, já gerou mais de 141 milhões de MWh de energia, reduzindo cerca de seis milhões de toneladas de carbono por ano através do Mecanismo de Desenvolvimento Limpo da ONU. A usina oferece o melhor índice de disponibilidade entre as hidrelétricas de grande porte do país, maximizando o aproveitamento das águas do Rio Madeira.

Fundada em valores como ética, segurança, integridade, comprometimento, confiança e senso de dono, a empresa promove o desenvolvimento sustentável, valorização dos recursos humanos, diversidade e inclusão, além da conservação dos recursos naturais e patrimônio cultural.

description:
Join a High-Performance Startup Focused on Building the Future of AI-Driven Paid Acquisition Performance Marketing

At WKND, we’re not just another agency—we’re shaping a tech-driven future where AI-powered solutions revolutionize how brands acquire and retain customers. While we currently excel as a performance marketing and creative strategy firm, our long-term vision is to develop scalable software platforms that help eCommerce brands maximize their growth, profitability, and brand loyalty.

We don’t follow trends—we create them. Our approach is anchored in speed, innovation, and execution at the highest level, redefining performance and retention marketing in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

Relentless Pursuit of Excellence

At WKND, excellence isn’t optional—it’s our standard. We have cultivated a performance-first culture where outcomes reign supreme. Whether it takes three hours or three hundred, our goal remains the same: deliver world-class results with a tangible impact. Every team member is empowered to think critically, act decisively, and solve complex problems at scale. This is not a place for those seeking routine—it’s for those who thrive under pressure and are driven by transformative outcomes.

Innovation at Speed

We exist to outpace the speed of innovation in our industry. WKND’s work culture is defined by accountability, speed, and a commitment to continuous improvement. We don’t just meet expectations—we exceed them. By leveraging advanced AI and automation, we craft data-driven marketing strategies that deliver measurable ROI for our clients while setting new standards in acquisition and retention.

Uncompromising Standards

Our team acts with a founder’s mentality—taking full ownership of their work and upholding exceptionally high standards. Collaboration, precision, and simplicity fuel our execution. Every process we design is built to scale without unnecessary complexity, ensuring each solution is as potent as it is elegant.

Customer-Centric Mission

Our clients’ success is our driving force. We are obsessed with creating exceptional experiences that empower global DTC brands to attract, convert, and retain customers at scale. From high-performing ad campaigns and creative iterations to AI-driven marketing solutions, we’re laser-focused on delivering strategies that surpass expectations and fuel sustained growth.

Visionary Thinking

At WKND, we don’t just look at where marketing stands today—we anticipate where it’s going tomorrow. We operate with a forward-thinking mindset, exploring how AI and emerging tech will reshape both acquisition and retention strategies over the next decade. Join us in laying the foundation for the future of eCommerce growth.

This is your chance to be part of a team where excellence is non-negotiable, and rewards are directly tied to performance. If you’re ready to tackle challenges, push boundaries, and define the future of data-driven marketing, WKND is where you belong. We don’t just aim to compete—we aim to lead.

The Power of Communication

At WKND, clear, proactive communication is the backbone of our high-performance culture. We believe in staying ahead of potential issues rather than reacting after problems arise. By sharing insights, challenges, and wins early and often, we maintain transparency, solve complex problems faster, and keep our teams fully aligned. This approach fosters accountability not just within individual departments but across the entire organization—everyone owns their deliverables while working cohesively toward common objectives.

As a consultative expert , you will bridge the gap between our internal strategies and our external partners’ growth initiatives and business goals. This involves active listening —genuinely hearing and understanding each stakeholder’s perspective, then offering thoughtful recommendations that drive both short-term impact and long-term success. By practicing intentional thought partnership and close collaboration, you’ll build strong, trusting relationships that ensure our clients feel heard, supported, and set up for success. Ultimately, this culture of open dialogue and empathy elevates everyone’s contributions—enabling us to deliver world-class outcomes at speed.

Why Join WKND?

  • Build Innovative SaaS Solutions
    Contribute to developing scalable software designed for global eCommerce markets.
  • Solve Mission-Critical Challenges
    Address complex acquisition and business challenges using AI-powered tools that drive efficiency, engagement, and ROI.
  • Pace of Innovation
    Operate at the cutting edge of AI technology, where bold thinking and agility are the keys to success.
  • Performance-Based Rewards
    Benefit from a competitive compensation structure with stock options, directly aligning your growth with our company’s trajectory.
  • Relentless Pursuit of Excellence
    Collaborate with a team that values meaningful outcomes over mere effort and recognizes truly exceptional results.

Role Overview

As a Sr. Paid Social Acquisition Specialist , you will be a senior-level expert driving full-funnel paid social media strategies to fuel our clients’ growth. You’ll execute and optimize campaigns across major social platforms, ensuring they meet and exceed performance targets while aligning with broader marketing initiatives. With your strong communication skills, strategic thinking, and results-driven approach, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate creative, retention, and conversion rate optimization efforts into cohesive campaigns.

This role offers a clear path to leadership – you’ll work alongside our Paid Media Manager (PMM) to accomplish key business objectives and initiatives, positioning yourself for future growth into roles like Paid Media Manager. If you’re a data-savvy, innovative marketer passionate about leveraging AI and rapid experimentation to scale DTC brands, this opportunity is your next big challenge.

Key Responsibilities

  • Paid Social Campaign Execution & Optimization: Plan, launch, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms (e.g., Facebook/Instagram, TikTok) to drive customer acquisition and retention. Implement audience segmentation, targeting, messaging, and bidding strategies, continuously A/B testing creatives and audience approaches to maximize engagement and conversions. Ensure all campaigns align with client goals and WKND’s performance benchmarks for measurable outcomes.
  • Full-Funnel Strategy & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Align paid social initiatives with broader direct-to-consumer growth strategies, ensuring a cohesive full-funnel approach from prospecting to retention. Work closely with creative, email/SMS, conversion rate optimization, SEO, and content teams to integrate campaign efforts and share insights. Ensure consistent messaging and leverage cross-channel learnings to improve marketing efficiency and customer lifetime value.
  • Data Analysis & KPI Management: Leverage advanced analytics platforms and AI-driven tools to monitor campaign performance and inform optimizations. Track and analyze key metrics – including return on ad spend (ROAS), customer acquisition cost (CAC), marketing efficiency ratio (MER), click-through rate (CTR), average order value (AOV), and CAC-to-LTV ratio – adjusting budgets and strategy to exceed targets. Use data-driven insights to make timely optimizations that improve ROI and scale results.
  • Insightful Reporting & Presentations: Compile and present detailed performance reports that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Create visually compelling presentations for internal teams and clients, highlighting campaign results, trends, and strategic recommendations. Communicate the story behind the numbers, enabling informed decision-making and demonstrating the value of our paid social efforts.
  • Client Communication Support: Support the Paid Media Manager in delivering top-notch client service through effective communication. Participate in occasional client calls or meetings to provide updates, explain campaign performance, and answer questions with professionalism and clarity. Help maintain transparent, trusting relationships by ensuring clients understand campaign progress and value.
  • Strategic Initiative Execution: Partner with the PMM to execute key business initiatives and special projects in paid media. Translate high-level objectives into actionable campaign plans and take ownership of their successful implementation. Proactively contribute ideas and optimizations that drive business goals, demonstrating leadership potential and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • AI-Driven Innovator: You’re passionate about leveraging AI and automation to push the limits of what's possible, always looking for ways to deliver scalable, cutting-edge solutions that drive success.
  • Tech Visionary: You thrive in environments that challenge you to innovate, embracing new technologies and harnessing them to create transformative, future-proof SaaS platforms.
  • Creative Problem Solver: You’re not afraid to think outside the box, tackling complex challenges with fresh perspectives and finding solutions that have a lasting impact.
  • Collaborative Team Player: You excel in communicating complex ideas clearly, working seamlessly across teams, and contributing to a culture of open collaboration to achieve ambitious goals.
  • Results-Oriented & Data-Driven: You’re obsessed with data, continuously interpreting metrics to relentlessly optimize campaigns and drive unparalleled ROI. You’re not just meeting targets—you’re exceeding them.
  • Platform Proficiency & Digital Mastery: You’re a wizard across paid platforms like Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, and more, with a sharp understanding of AI-driven optimization tools that push performance to new heights.
  • Proactive & Adaptable: You’re always ahead of the curve, staying on top of platform changes and anticipating challenges before they arise. You pivot with agility, turning potential obstacles into growth opportunities

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing or a related field (required) .
  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience in paid social (required) , with a deep understanding of paid acquisition and media buying strategies. Proven ability to scale campaigns, manage substantial budgets, and consistently meet or exceed key performance targets.
  • Technical Skills: Highly knowledgeable in bidding and targeting automation tools; proficient in Google Analytics and other ad management/testing platforms.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent project management and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to structure complex, multi-stakeholder projects effectively. Strong written and verbal communication skills for both client-facing and internal collaboration.
  • Performance Culture: Thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and effective time-management.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Base Salary: Calibrated to attract top talent who thrive under high expectations.
  • Generous Stock Options: Align your success with the company’s trajectory and shared prosperity.
  • Performance-Based Bonuses: Earn additional rewards for surpassing key growth milestones and metrics.
  • Access to Advanced Development Tools & Resources: Stay on the cutting edge with the latest AI-driven marketing technologies.
  • High-Performance Culture: Be part of a team where your contributions are noticed, celebrated, and rewarded for driving real impact.
  • Healthcare & Wellness Options (available upon request): Designed to support your well-being and peace of mind.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Work remotely or in-office, as long as you meet deadlines and deliver exceptional results.

Ready to Shape the Future of Paid Acquisition & Paid Social — And Revolutionize with AI?

Join WKND as a Senior Paid Social Acquisition Specialist and become a pivotal force behind high-performing, AI-enhanced campaigns for top DTC brands. You won’t just execute ads—you’ll help shape strategy, pioneer new approaches in paid social, and contribute to our bold shift toward an AI-driven SaaS model.

If you’re passionate about delivering transformative outcomes, driving exponential growth, and advancing your career in a cutting-edge environment, WKND is where you belong .
Apply now to join our high-performance team, harness AI-driven insights, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in digital marketing. Together, we’ll redefine eCommerce growth and achieve exceptional results for our clients.

title: Vendedor Externo - Rio de Janeiro (Banco de Talentos)
description:
Job description

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália e Chile.

A oportunidade em questão está alocada na nossa área de Mercado Interno ( vendas dentro do Brasil).

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.


Main responsibilities

Você será responsável pela gestão da carteira de clientes, identificando oportunidades, prestando consultoria de produtos, fazendo prospecção de clientes food service e varejo.

Analisar e estudar o mercado para melhor atender o cliente;

Acompanhar toda as etapas da entrega do produto, desde o pedido de vendas a entrega final, garantindo a qualidade do atendimento.

Gosta da área comercial? Gosta de vender e atender clientes?Tem interesse na área foods varejo?

Essa oportunidade é para você!!!


Requirements and skills

• Ensino médio completo;

• Possuir veículo próprio e habilitação B;

• Conhecimento em vendas externas;

• Conhecimento básico no pacote office;

• Desejável conhecimento na região de atuação


Additional information

• Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;

• Remuneração Variável e PPR semestral;

• VR/VA;

• Wellhub;

• Ajuda de custo;

• Seguro de vida.

- Um diploma universitário em sistemas é uma vantagem.

- Nível avançado de inglês.

- Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.

- Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário.

- Licença parental remunerada, férias, e feriados nacionais.

- Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.

- Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.

- Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades, e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.

Junte-se a uma equipe global onde seus talentos excepcionais podem se destacar!

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Reboot Monkey is seeking an experienced Technical Recruiter with advanced headhunting skills and LinkedIn proficiency to recruit Data Center Engineers and Technicians worldwide . The recruiter will be responsible for sourcing, engaging, and hiring the best talent across global regions. This role demands strategic thinking and creativity in identifying passive candidates and developing effective sourcing strategies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Headhunting & Talent Acquisition :

    • Manage the entire recruitment process including job posting, sourcing, interviewing, offer negotiation, and onboarding for technical positions.

    • Leverage headhunting techniques to identify and engage with highly skilled Data Center Engineers/Technicians globally.

    • Build a strong pipeline of candidates through networking, referrals, and proactive outreach.

    • Conduct screening interviews to assess technical skills, cultural fit, and experience.

  • Recruitment Tools & Documentation :

    • Utilize DocuSign for managing contracts and other recruitment-related documentation.

    • Track candidate progress and manage recruitment pipelines using Recruitee and Jira.

    • Ensure compliance with global hiring processes and documentation requirements.

  • Collaboration :

    • Partner with hiring managers and project leads to understand the specific technical requirements of data center projects.

    • Collaborate with global teams to coordinate time-sensitive recruitment efforts across different time zones.

  • Market Research & Process Improvement :

    • Stay informed on global market trends in data center recruitment to ensure competitive sourcing strategies.

    • Continuously refine headhunting and outreach strategies to attract high-quality candidates.

    • Provide feedback on the recruitment process and suggest ways to improve efficiency and candidate experience.
      Compensation 400 - 500 Euros Monthly


  • Qualification :

    • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field. Relevant certifications in recruiting are a plus.

    • Minimum of 2 years of experience in technical recruiting.

    • Strong headhunting expertise, particularly for hard-to-fill technical roles such as Data Center Engineers/Technicians.

    • Proficient in LinkedIn recruiting, including advanced search techniques, outreach, and maintaining a professional network.

    • Familiarity with recruitment tools like Recruitee , DocuSign , and Jira .

    • Bilingual candidates are considered an asset.

  • Skills :

    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships with passive candidates.

    • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail to manage multiple recruitment pipelines effectively.

    • Ability to evaluate technical skills and qualifications relevant to data center operations.

  • Remote Work Requirements :

    • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment, managing priorities effectively.

    • Stable internet connection and workspace for professional communication.

Que tal fazer parte do nosso time como Pessoa Engenheira de Dados?
Sua missão será desenvolver e implementar soluções de dados utilizando sua experiência e habilidades em ferramentas e tecnologias como Airflow, Databricks, Python, SQL e Power BI.
Essa é uma oportunidade para atuar no modelo híbrido no Rio de Janeiro.
RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Como Pessoa Engenheira De Dados, Você Focará Em

  • Desenvolvimento de Pipelines de Dados: Projetar, desenvolver e implementar pipelines de dados eficientes e escaláveis utilizando majoritariamente Airflow, Python e SQL, garantindo a integridade e a confiabilidade dos dados.
  • Análise e Transformação de Dados: Realizar análises complexas e transformações de dados utilizando SQL e outras ferramentas, garantindo a entrega de insights acionáveis para a tomada de decisões informadas.
  • Integração de Dados: Integrar e unificar dados de diversas fontes e formatos, utilizando plataformas como Databricks, para criar conjuntos de dados completos e coesos.
  • Visualização de Dados: Desenvolver dashboards interativos e relatórios personalizados utilizando o Power BI, para comunicar eficazmente insights e tendências de negócios aos stakeholders.
  • Otimização de Desempenho: Identificar e implementar melhorias de desempenho nos processos de dados, otimizando consultas SQL, ajustando configurações de pipelines e refinando modelos de dados.
  • Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de negócios, desenvolvimento e outras áreas funcionais para entender requisitos de dados e garantir a entrega de soluções alinhadas às necessidades da organização.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
Como Requisitos Básicos, Buscamos
  • Experiência comprovada como Pessoa Engenheira de Dados ou Analista de Dados em ambientes corporativos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas e tecnologias como Python, Airflow, Databricks, AWS, SQL e Power BI.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de pipelines de dados, análise de dados, integração/ingestão de dados e visualização de dados.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em soluções de dados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.
Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you
Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.
Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.
This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.
The role entails

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study
Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Ubuntu Core Software Engineer to redefine the Linux experience in the embedded environments with the smallest, most secure, and updatable operating system in the IoT market. This is an opportunity for a software engineer passionate about open source software, Linux, security, and the developer experience. This challenging role demands a high degree of technical skill with low-level operating systems, kernel, and device firmware.
Our mission is to allow everyone to build robust solutions in various fields including but not limited to IoT, automotive, and aviation using the next generation secure embedded Linux operating system in a simple solution. We define a reliable and secure set of device recovery mechanisms that enable device manufacturers to simplify and standardise the field operations for fleets of heterogeneous appliances.
As an Ubuntu Core team member, you'll be designing and implementing software that runs on various CPU architectures, such as ARM, RISC-V, and X86. You will work on boot mechanisms, bootloaders, storage partition layout, device trees, kernel and services.
Build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company.
Location : This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region
The role entails

  • Write high quality code with unit tests to create new features
  • Debug Linux system level issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Integrate diverse bootloaders and maintain gadget snaps
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 times a year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have experience with C or Golang, and Shell
  • You have a solid understanding of Linux and a modern GNU/Linux distribution, Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • You have personal or professional experience with Linux-capable devices such as Raspberry Pi
  • You have interest in learning or experience in one or more low-level systems and security facilities such as:
    • Bootloaders in ARM and X86, such as piboot, uboot, grub-uefi
    • Systemd and units, udev, initrd, graphics
    • OS level firmware daemons and CLI applications
    • Linux security implementations - TPM, FDE, LUKS, HSM, etc.
  • You may have experience or knowledge of Yocto
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity , we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Desenvolvedor De Integração
description:
Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor de Integração que atuará como responsável técnico pela camada de integração entre os sistemas SAP (ERP S/4HANA e IS-U HANA) e os sistemas legados da Light, aplicando práticas de DevSecOps para garantir entregas seguras, escaláveis, automatizadas e de alta disponibilidade. O profissional será peça-chave na sustentação de pipelines, automação de deploys, governança de APIs e segurança das integrações, assegurando performance e integridade dos fluxos críticos de dados.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para a Light !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração.
  2. Garantir que todas as integrações respeitem os padrões de segurança da informação, auditoria, criptografia e compliance regulatório.
  3. Desenvolver e monitorar APIs, middlewares (SAP PI/PO, CPI, etc.), conectores e mensagerias (ex: Kafka, RabbitMQ), assegurando o funcionamento contínuo dos fluxos de dados.
  4. Estabelecer boas práticas de versionamento, CI/CD, segregação de ambientes, testes automatizados e rollback.
  5. Trabalhar em conjunto com os times de BASIS, segurança, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento ABAP/Java e fornecedores externos.
  6. Apoiar o controle de acesso a serviços de integração, utilizando mecanismos como OAuth2, certificados digitais, SAML, etc.
  7. Monitorar, diagnosticar e resolver falhas nos pipelines de integração com foco em resiliência.
  8. Documentar fluxos, endpoints, dependências e procedimentos operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  1. Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.
  2. Experiência com ferramentas e práticas DevSecOps aplicadas a projetos SAP e/ou integrações corporativas.
  3. Conhecimento em SAP PI/PO, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), API Management, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, ODATA e WebServices.
  4. Experiência com integração segura (HTTPS, JWT, certificados, SSO, firewalls).
  5. Conhecimento em containers (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes, OpenShift).
  6. Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  7. Automação de testes e validações em integrações.
  8. Conhecimento em monitoramento de logs e métricas (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, etc.).
  9. Familiaridade com ambientes SAP híbridos (cloud/on-premise).
  10. Conhecimento prévio de integrações com sistemas de utilities (ex: sistemas de medição, CRM legado, gestão de redes, etc.).
  11. Experiência com SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;

  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

Somos uma das maiores empresas privadas do setor elétrico brasileiro que atua, por meio de uma cadeia de valor integrada nos processos de geração, transmissão e distribuição de energia para 31 municípios do Rio de Janeiro, além da comercialização de energia para todo o Brasil.

description:

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.

Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring tools (e.g., Revit, Tekla, Archicad).
  • Experience in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks, Revizto).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie) and model checking (e.g., Solibri).
  • Knowledge of CDE platforms (Aconex, BIM 360) and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera).
  • Visual programming (Dynamo) and Power BI experience preferred.
  • Understanding of 4D/5D BIM workflows and outputs.
  • Strong communicator with collaborative mindset.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive.
  • Resilient under pressure with strong time management.
  • Passionate about digital innovation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

title: Python Developer - Remote
description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 240 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organisations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About the Job:

Are you interested in building web crawlers harnessing the Zyte platform, which powers crawls of over 3 billion pages a month?

Do you like working in a company with a strong open source foundation?

Zyte is looking for Software Engineers to join our Delivery team to work on web crawler development with Scrapy, our flagship, open source project.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and maintain Scrapy web crawlers.
  • Leverage the Zyte platform and our open source projects to perform distributed information extraction, retrieval and data processing
  • Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues with distributed crawling at scale
  • Help identify, debug and fix problems with open source projects, including Scrapy

Zyte’s platform and Delivery offerings have been growing tremendously over the past couple of years but there are a lot of big projects waiting in the pipeline, and in this role you would be a key part of that process. Here’s what we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of software development experience in Python.
  • Solid Python knowledge.
  • Familiarity with Linux/UNIX, HTTP, HTML, Javascript and Networking.
  • Good communication in written and spoken English
  • Availability to work full time.

Bonus points for:

  • Scrapy experience is a big plus.
  • Familiarity with techniques and tools for crawling, extracting and processing data (e.g. Scrapy, NLTK, pandas, scikit-learn, mapreduce, nosql, etc).
  • Proficient English

As a new Zytan, you will:

Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.

Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.

Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.

Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

35 days paid holidays

Engenheiro(a) de Machine Learning – LLMs

Meta Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Atribuições Principais
Implementar e ajustar modelos de linguagem natural (LLMs) baseados em arquiteturas open-source como LLaMA, com foco em desempenho, escalabilidade e eficiência computacional;

O que procuramos?
Atribuições Principais
Implementar e ajustar modelos de linguagem natural (LLMs) baseados em arquiteturas open-source como LLaMA, com foco em desempenho, escalabilidade e eficiência computacional;
Executar o fine-tuning de modelos, realizando pré-processamento de dados, tokenização e ajustes específicos para o contexto de negócio;
Desenvolver e integrar APIs (utilizando frameworks como FastAPI ou Flask) para viabilizar o uso dos modelos em aplicações reais;
Colaborar com arquitetos de IA e outros membros da equipe técnica para garantir alinhamento com a arquitetura de soluções definida;
Aplicar práticas sólidas de engenharia de software, incluindo versionamento de código (Git), testes automatizados e documentação técnica;
Utilizar containers (Docker) e ferramentas de orquestração (Kubernetes) para deploy e execução eficiente dos modelos em ambientes produtivos;
Contribuir para o monitoramento e melhoria contínua dos modelos e pipelines, considerando métricas de performance e consumo de recursos;
Atuar com foco em qualidade, segurança e manutenibilidade do código, seguindo padrões técnicos estabelecidos;
Participar de iniciativas de inovação, contribuindo com boas práticas, novas ideias e/ou participação em comunidades técnicas (desejável);
Explorar ferramentas de MLOps, como MLflow ou Weights & Biases, para versionamento de experimentos e rastreabilidade de modelos (quando aplicável).
Requisitos

  • Experiência prática com PyTorch;
  • Familiaridade com LLaMA ou outros modelos transformer open-source;
  • Familiaridade com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em pré-processamento de dados, tokenização e fine-tuning;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs (ex: FastAPI ou Flask);
  • Conhecimento de versionamento (Git), testes e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Capacidade de seguir diretrizes técnicas definidas pela arquitetura.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com execução otimizada de LLMs em GPU ;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de MLOps (MLflow, W&B, etc.);
  • Projetos práticos ou repositórios com uso de modelos de linguagem;
  • Experiência com integração de modelos em aplicações reais;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, eventos ou projetos open-source.
Localidade da posição: Presencial no Centro do Rio de Janeiro.
Por que construir sua carreira na Meta?
Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade de interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais crescem no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.
Quais são nossos valores?
  • Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
  • Pensamos e agimos como donos
  • Temos gana por performance
  • Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
  • Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade
  • Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA
Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.
Se identificou? Então, #VemSerMeta!

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop.
We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.
This job posting is our general process for Rust engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Rust. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.
Canonical has substantial projects in Python, Go, C, C++ and we are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.
Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home-based and distributed environment. These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux - the more different versions of Linux the better!
Location : we have open roles for Rust engineers in every time zone.
What your day will look like

  • Design and implement well-tested and well-documented software in Rust
  • Advocate for Rust adoption in Canonical and upstream projects
  • Identify projects and codebases that could be prioritised for Rust adoption
  • Debug and fix issues encountered by your users

  • Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications

  • In some cases, deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • For more senior roles, experience building, deploying, and operating distributed systems and APIs
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience designing and writing high-quality Rust software on Linux
  • Experience with and passion for Linux at the system level
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Nice-to-have skills we would value
  • Experience developing for Ubuntu
  • Experience with LXD, MicroK8s, SnapD, IoT, Juju, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Join to apply for the Senior Technical Sales role at Shape Digital

As a Senior Technical Sales , you will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to realize high-impact engagements with clients in asset-intensive industries such as Oil & Gas, Mining, Energy, and Pulp & Paper. Your role is essential in communicating the value of our AI and advanced analytics solutions, influencing our clients' digital transformation journeys.
We are looking for a strategic and hands-on professional with solid experience in pre-sales, solution design, or software consulting who enjoys working directly with customers and translating business challenges into powerful technical solutions.
Responsibilities

  • Conduct high-impact engagements with senior technical and business stakeholders to understand strategic goals and operational pain points.
  • Present sophisticated AI and analytics-based software solutions aligned with the client’s asset management, performance and sustainability objectives.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations, use case walkthroughs, and value narratives for C-level and operational decision-makers.
  • Architect tailored solutions using the company’s portfolio of industrial software, balancing feasibility, scalability, and ROI.
  • Own the development of complex proposals, including technical documentation, project scope, budget estimates, and commercial models.
  • Collaborate closely with the Sales, Marketing, Client Services and Product teams to influence market positioning, go-to-market strategy, and customer success.
  • Provide market intelligence, voice-of-customer insights, and competitive analysis to inform product roadmap and business strategy.
  • Support enterprise negotiations and build long-term client relationships that generate recurring business opportunities.
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a technical discipline; Master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent experience strongly preferred.
  • Solid experience in technical sales, solution consulting, or pre-sales within industrial software, SaaS, or analytics companies.
  • Deep understanding of asset performance management (APM), industrial data infrastructure (e.g., OSIsoft PI, SCADA, Historians), or enterprise asset management (EAM) platforms like SAP PM or Maximo.
  • Expertise in analytics, machine learning, or AI technologies applied to reliability, production optimization, or operations.
  • Proven ability to map business drivers to technical solutions and communicate value at multiple levels of an organization.
  • Skilled in developing complex proposals, business cases, and ROI models.
  • Familiarity with enterprise sales processes and long-cycle B2B negotiations.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.
Differential
  • Experience with industrial software platforms or digital transformation in asset-intensive industries.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and integration with industrial data systems.
  • Background in consulting or working in Agile, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Other languages besides English and Portuguese.

  • Day Off in Your Birthday Month: Celebrate your way.
  • Extended Maternity/Paternity Leave: Quality time with your growing family.
  • Childcare Assistance: Support for caring for your little ones.
  • Continuous Development Support: Personalized learning and growth aligned with your goals.

  • Familiaridade com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em pré-processamento de dados, tokenização e fine-tuning;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs (ex: FastAPI ou Flask);
  • Conhecimento de versionamento (Git), testes e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Capacidade de seguir diretrizes técnicas definidas pela arquitetura.
